{"summary":"当前草稿第11章显示：林默走进北门，银钥匙已交给陈澈，她此时已知道弟弟还活着。已确认记忆显示温岚仍持有黄铜罗盘，且她尚不知廊桥钥匙的含义。","summary_sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-1"},{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-2"},{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-3"}],"items":[{"section":"character_state","text":"当前草稿中，林默走进北门。","sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-1"}]},{"section":"character_state","text":"当前草稿中，银钥匙已经交给陈澈。","sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-2"}]},{"section":"character_state","text":"当前草稿中，她此时已经知道弟弟还活着。","sources":[{"source_type":"draft_claim","source_id":"draft-claim-draft-f546f392-553e-4908-9f0e-32fb4f79052b-r2-3"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认记忆：温岚尚不知道廊桥钥匙的含义。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-ea6a6e39-5451-4062-9b49-04baa995b04a"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认记忆：黄铜罗盘的持有者是温岚。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-ccb0d23e-6ab5-4727-a8ef-c1efcb2c25ef"}]},{"section":"confirmed_fact","text":"已确认记忆：航图位于雾线水门外锚柱。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-1bae8ca8-8c8f-4fdc-9025-3b52ed60c022"}]},{"section":"world_rule","text":"已确认设定：灰港雾钟只在北潮闸完全关闭后敲响一次。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-aff6a46f-1198-4253-a8bb-c2cbb961ce50"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：白色渡船没有靠岸，来源未明。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-2a0fbf9a-d8c0-4d42-925f-ef98fb415962"}]},{"section":"open_thread","text":"未解线索：异常雾钟在北潮闸未关闭时响起，原因未解。","sources":[{"source_type":"memory_record","source_id":"mem-5aecb1c7-6309-417d-be1a-0671d794c1fc"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第10章《回声坐标》中，北潮闸并未关闭，雾钟却响了一次；温岚仍握着罗盘，港外传来白色渡船的汽笛。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-cde21f23-d9eb-479b-af46-2c873ccd4cad"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第8章《北堤灯火》中，温岚把北堤值守簿交给苏岑，两人约定不再各自隐瞒新线索。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-3ce58396-ae48-433e-8112-243b79f05a16"}]},{"section":"recent_source","text":"第6章《低室电台》中，电台在二十一点零五分收到三次短促求救码，信号来自雾线水门以外。","sources":[{"source_type":"source_span","source_id":"span-b7a883d4-f40a-4f54-97eb-9061ad0e6694"}]}]}
